ArchRow.description:
A rise-to-span range of an arched roof: windward quarter Cp = a·r + b (and the alternate
coefficient that shall also be used, where given).

elevated.description: Roof on an elevated structure (else from the ground).
elevated.title: Elevated

ArchRow.title: ArchRow

ArchedTable.description: Arched roofs: windward quarter by r, centre half Cp = a·r + b, leeward quarter Cp.
ArchedTable.title: ArchedTable

ChimneyRow.description:
Cf of a cross-section and surface by h/D; ``small``: rounded with D√qz up to the
limit.
ChimneyRow.title: ChimneyRow

ChimneysTable.description:
Chimneys, tanks, rooftop equipment and similar structures, F = qz·G·Cf·Af (read by
:mod:`saengine.fem.other_wind`).

roundLimit.description: D√qz limit of round sections (D m, qz N/m²).
roundLimit.title: Roundlimit

ChimneysTable.title: ChimneysTable

CladdingArchedTable.description:
Arched roofs: at the perimeter, the roof figures with θ the springline slope; elsewhere
the MWFRS arched roof Cp times ``interiorFactor``.
CladdingArchedTable.title: CladdingArchedTable

CladdingCurve.description:
One external pressure coefficient (GCp) of components and cladding: ``gcp1`` at an
effective wind area up to ``area1`` [m²], ``gcp2`` from ``area2``, linear in log A between.
CladdingCurve.title: CladdingCurve

CladdingDomeTable.description:
Domes on a circular base: (GCp) by the angle θ from the springline (0) to the top (90),
with q at the top of the dome; the figure's range of hD/D and f/D.
CladdingDomeTable.title: CladdingDomeTable

CladdingPointCurve.description:
One external pressure coefficient (GCp) of components and cladding by effective wind area:
(area [m²], GCp) points, linear in log A between them, the end values beyond the ends.
CladdingPointCurve.title: CladdingPointCurve

CladdingRoofTable.description:
The (GCp) of the roofs of one form over a range of roof angles θ (angleFrom < θ ≤
angleTo) for low-rise buildings (read by :func:`saengine.fem.loads.cladding_pressures`).

forms.description: Roof forms this figure covers (gable, hip, monoslope, ...).
forms.title: Forms

roof.description: Roof zones; empty: the low-rise flat-roof curves.
roof.title: Roof

overhang.description: Roof overhangs (top and bottom surfaces together).
overhang.title: Overhang

zoneLabels.description: What each zone of this figure is (its plan).
zoneLabels.title: Zonelabels

cornerAsEdge.description: Form -> θ [°] up to which roof zone 3 is treated as zone 2 (hip roofs).
cornerAsEdge.title: Cornerasedge

parapetCornerAsEdge.description: A parapet of at least the cladding table's parapetCorner turns zone 3 into zone 2 on this figure's roofs.
parapetCornerAsEdge.title: Parapetcornerasedge

envelopeForm.description: Also take the larger magnitude of this form's figure at the same angle (zone by its number), where the code's text points to both.
envelopeForm.title: Envelopeform

CladdingRoofTable.title: CladdingRoofTable

CladdingSteppedRoof.description:
The lower level of a flat stepped roof: its zones at the roof-upper wall intersection
renamed (``zoneMap``), and the wall's positive (GCp) on a strip b = widthFactor·h1 ≤
widthMax wide; the figure's limits on h1 and the ratios.
CladdingSteppedRoof.title: CladdingSteppedRoof

CladdingTable.description:
Components and cladding (BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 2.4.11.5): the (GCp) curves of walls and
flat roofs (θ ≤ 10°) of low-rise (h ≤ ``lowRiseHeight``) and taller buildings, the internal
pressure coefficients and the edge-zone width a.

lowRiseHeight.description: h [m] up to which the low-rise curves hold.
lowRiseHeight.title: Lowriseheight

lowRiseWallFactor.description: Factor on the low-rise wall (GCp) for a roof θ ≤ 10°.
lowRiseWallFactor.title: Lowrisewallfactor

internal.description: (GCpi) magnitude by enclosure; None: the wind table's internalPressure.
internal.title: Internal

parapetCorner.description: A parapet this high [m] or more turns roof zone 3 into zone 2.
parapetCorner.title: Parapetcorner

wallFactorMaxAngle.description: lowRiseWallFactor only for a roof θ up to this [°]; None: any.
wallFactorMaxAngle.title: Wallfactormaxangle

roofs.description: Roof figures by form and angle; empty: flat roofs only.
roofs.title: Roofs

highRiseRoofsFrom.description: h above lowRiseHeight with a roof θ above this [°]: the low-rise roof figures with qh; None: the high-rise flat-roof curves at any θ.
highRiseRoofsFrom.title: Highriseroofsfrom

parapetPositive.description: With a parapet (as parapetCorner): roof zone -> wall zone whose positive (GCp) the roof zone takes.
parapetPositive.title: Parapetpositive

CladdingTable.title: CladdingTable

DomeCurve.description:
Cp at one point of a dome (A windward springline, B top, C leeward springline) against
f/D, for one hD/D.
DomeCurve.title: DomeCurve

DomeTable.description:
Domed roofs on a circular base: Cp at A, B and C by f/D and hD/D, Case A interpolated
along arcs A-B-C, Case B constant A up to ``caseBAngle`` then to B and C.

minRise.description: Below this f/D, the planar roof table holds.
minRise.title: Minrise

DomeTable.title: DomeTable

FlexibleGustRow.description:
The gust-effect factor Gf of a flexible or dynamically sensitive building (BNBC 2020 Part 6
Sec 2.4.8.2): read by :func:`saengine.fem.loads.flexible_gust_factor`.

frequencyLimit.description: A building below n1 [Hz] is flexible.
frequencyLimit.title: Frequencylimit

gQ.description: Peak factor of the background response gQ.
gQ.title: Gq

gv.description: Peak factor of the wind response gv.
gv.title: Gv

damping.description: Damping ratio β of a concrete building.
damping.title: Damping

eccentricity.description: Torsional eccentricity of a flexible building: gustWeighted, e from eQ and eR weighted by the background and resonant responses (:func:`saengine.fem.loads.flexible_eccentricity`); None: the rigid e.
eccentricity.title: Eccentricity

FlexibleGustRow.title: FlexibleGustRow

InternalPressureTable.description:
Internal pressure coefficients (GCpi) by enclosure classification and the reduction
factor Ri of a partially enclosed building with one unpartitioned large volume:
Ri = reductionBase·(1 + 1/√(1 + Vi/(volumeFactor·Aog))) ≤ 1, Vi the internal volume [m³],
Aog the total area of openings in the envelope [m²]
(read by :func:`saengine.fem.loads.internal_pressure_coefficient`).

volumeFactor.description: The constant before Aog in Ri [m].
volumeFactor.title: Volumefactor

InternalPressureTable.title: InternalPressureTable

LatticeCfRow.description:
Force coefficient Cf of an open sign or lattice framework up to a solidity ratio ε: by
member shape, flat-sided or rounded (small and large D√qz).

solidityMax.description: Row holds for ε below this.
solidityMax.title: Soliditymax

roundSmall.description: Cf, rounded members, D√qz up to the limit.
roundSmall.title: Roundsmall

roundLarge.description: Cf, rounded members, D√qz above the limit.
roundLarge.title: Roundlarge

LatticeCfRow.title: LatticeCfRow

LowRiseTable.description:
Low-rise buildings: the combined (GCpf) by building surface and roof angle, the end
zones 2a wide, the zone 2 extent, the torsional load cases' share.

maxHeight.description: Low-rise: mean roof height h up to this [m].
maxHeight.title: Maxheight

zone2Fraction.description: Negative zone 2: up to this · L ...
zone2Fraction.title: Zone2Fraction

exemptHeight.description: One storey up to this h: no torsional cases.
exemptHeight.title: Exemptheight

LowRiseTable.title: LowRiseTable

MwfrsTable.description:
External pressures of the main wind-force resisting system on walls and roofs of
enclosed and partially enclosed buildings (read by :mod:`saengine.fem.loads` and
:mod:`saengine.fem.open_wind`).

overhang.description: Cp on the underside of a windward roof overhang.
overhang.title: Overhang

MwfrsTable.title: MwfrsTable

OpenBuildingsTable.description:
Open buildings with monoslope, pitched or troughed free roofs: p = qh·G·CN for the
main wind-force resisting system and the components and cladding (read by
:mod:`saengine.fem.open_wind`).

minAngle.description: Below this θ [°], every form takes the monoslope's first row.
minAngle.title: Minangle

OpenBuildingsTable.title: OpenBuildingsTable

flatMonoslopeAngle.description: A monoslope roof below this θ [°] takes these zones ...
flatMonoslopeAngle.title: Flatmonoslopeangle

flatMonoslopeRatio.description: ... for the wind normal to its slope too, with h/L in this range.
flatMonoslopeRatio.title: Flatmonosloperatio

OpenRoofAlongZone.description:
A zone of a free roof by its horizontal distance from the windward edge (multiples of
h), wind parallel to the ridge: CN by load case, then by blockage.

upTo.description: Ends this many h from the edge.
upTo.title: Upto

OpenRoofAlongZone.title: OpenRoofAlongZone

areaBands.description: Band upper limits as multiples of a² (the last band: above).
areaBands.title: Areabands

ridgeEdgeFrom.description: θ [°] from which a pitched or troughed roof's ridge (valley) is an edge.
ridgeEdgeFrom.title: Ridgeedgefrom

OpenRoofCladdingRow.description:
CN of the components and cladding of a free roof at one angle: per blockage, per zone,
the (positive, negative) pair of each effective-area band.
OpenRoofCladdingRow.title: OpenRoofCladdingRow

OpenRoofMwfrs.description: Net pressure coefficients CN of the main wind-force resisting system of free roofs.
OpenRoofMwfrs.title: OpenRoofMwfrs

OpenRoofRow.description:
One roof angle and load case of an open building's free roof, wind normal to the ridge:
(CNW, CNL) the net pressure coefficients of the windward and leeward halves, by blockage;
``...Reverse`` for γ = 180° where the figure gives it (a monoslope roof: γ = 0° the wind
blows from the high eave down the slope, 180° up it).
OpenRoofRow.title: OpenRoofRow

OpenStructuresTable.description:
Design wind loads on other structures, F = qz·G·Cf·Af (BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 2.4, the
provisions of ASCE 7-05 Sec 6.5.15 and Figures 6-22, 6-23): open signs and lattice
frameworks, and trussed towers.

roundLimit.description: D√qz limit between the rounded-member columns (D in m, qz in N/m²).
roundLimit.title: Roundlimit

diagonalFactor.description: Square tower, wind on the diagonal: Cf × (1 + k·ε), at most the cap.
diagonalFactor.title: Diagonalfactor

roundTower.description: Factor on Cf of a tower of rounded members (a·ε² + b·ε + c), at most 1.

OpenStructuresTable.title: OpenStructuresTable

ReturnCorner.description:
The factor on the first region's Cf (B/s ≥ ``fromAspect``) with a return corner, by
Lr/s.
ReturnCorner.title: ReturnCorner

RoofCpRow.description:
One h/L row of a roof pressure coefficient table: per tabulated angle, the first
(suction) and second (pressure, where two are listed) Cp; None where none is printed (0.0 for
interpolation).
RoofCpRow.title: RoofCpRow

RoofCpTable.description:
Roof pressure coefficients Cp of the main wind-force resisting system (all heights): the
windward and leeward slopes for wind normal to the ridge (θ ≥ ``flatAngle``) by θ and h/L,
and the zones by distance from the windward edge for θ < ``flatAngle`` and wind parallel to
the ridge. Values between rows and angles are interpolated linearly between values of the
same column.

verticalFrom.description: θ [°] above which the slope takes verticalCp.
verticalFrom.title: Verticalfrom

flatAngle.description: θ [°] below which the roof is flat.
flatAngle.title: Flatangle

reducible.description: The Cp value that may be reduced with its area.
reducible.title: Reducible

RoofCpTable.title: RoofCpTable

RoofParallelZone.description:
A zone of the roof by its horizontal distance from the windward edge (in multiples of
h): Cp values listed (one or two).

upTo.description: Zone ends this many h from the windward edge; None: the rest.
upTo.title: Upto

RoofParallelZone.title: RoofParallelZone

RooftopTable.description:
The force on rooftop structures and equipment of a low building × ``factor`` for
Af ≤ ``fullShare``·B·h, linear down to 1 at Af = ``noneShare``·B·h.

maxHeight.description: Buildings with h up to this [m].
maxHeight.title: Maxheight

RooftopTable.title: RooftopTable

SolidSignRegion.description:
A region of a long sign (case C) up to ``end``·s from the windward edge (None: the rest):
Cf by the aspect ratios of the table, None where the sign is not that long.
SolidSignRegion.title: SolidSignRegion

SolidSignsCaseC.description:
Case C (B/s ≥ ``minAspect``): Cf of each region by B/s, × (``reductionConstant`` − s/h)
above s/h of ``reductionAbove``.
SolidSignsCaseC.title: SolidSignsCaseC

SolidSignsTable.description:
Solid freestanding walls and solid signs, F = qh·G·Cf·As (read by
:mod:`saengine.fem.other_wind`): Cf of cases A and B by s/h (``clearance``) and B/s
(``aspect``), case C by region.

solidMin.description: A sign is solid from this ε up.
solidMin.title: Solidmin

caseBOffset.description: Case B: F this × B toward the windward edge.
caseBOffset.title: Caseboffset

fullHeightLift.description: s/h = 1: F this × s above the centre.
fullHeightLift.title: Fullheightlift

SolidSignsTable.title: SolidSignsTable

TopographyShape.description: A topographic feature's speed-up parameters: K1/(H/Lh) by exposure, γ and μ.

muUpwind.description: Horizontal attenuation μ upwind of the crest.
muUpwind.title: Muupwind

muDownwind.description: Horizontal attenuation μ downwind of it.
muDownwind.title: Mudownwind

TopographyShape.title: TopographyShape

TopographyTable.description:
Wind speed-up over isolated hills, ridges and escarpments: Kzt = (1 + K1·K2·K3)² with
K1 = (K1/(H/Lh))·H/Lh, K2 = 1 − |x|/(μ·Lh), K3 = e^(−γ·z/Lh) (read by
:func:`saengine.fem.loads.topographic_factor`).

minSlope.description: No speed-up below H/Lh of this.
minSlope.title: Minslope

maxSlope.description: Above it, H/Lh is taken as this for K1 and Lh as H/this for K2, K3.
maxSlope.title: Maxslope

minHeight.description: No speed-up below a feature height H [m].
minHeight.title: Minheight

TopographyTable.title: TopographyTable

TowerCf.description: Cf = a·ε² + b·ε + c of a trussed tower's face.
TowerCf.title: TowerCf

WindDesignCasesRow.description:
The design wind load cases of the main wind-force resisting system (BNBC 2020 Part 6
Sec 2.4.11.3 and Figure 6.2.9): read by :func:`saengine.fem.loads.wind_design_cases`.

partial.description: Case 2: share of the pressure with torsion.
partial.title: Partial

simultaneousTorsional.description: Case 4: share of each direction with both torsions.
simultaneousTorsional.title: Simultaneoustorsional

WindDesignCasesRow.title: WindDesignCasesRow

source.description: Clause (and page) the table comes from.
source.title: Source

sources.description: Clause references of single entries: {key: clause}.
sources.title: Sources

designCases.description: Factors of the design wind load cases 2-4 (torsional, simultaneous); None: Case 1 only.

flexible.description: Gf of flexible buildings; None: rigid G only.

cladding.description: Components and cladding pressures; None: not computed.

internalPressure.description: Internal pressure coefficients and Ri; None: cladding's.

mwfrs.description: Wall and roof pressures of the main wind-force resisting system; None: storey forces only and no wind on clad special structures.

openBuildings.description: Net pressures on the free roofs of open buildings; None: an open clad structure takes force coefficients on its members instead.

openStructures.description: Force coefficients of open structures (lattice frameworks, trussed towers); None: special structures get no wind.

topography.description: Kzt of hills, ridges and escarpments; None: Kzt = topographic.

solidSigns.description: Cf of solid freestanding walls and signs; None: not covered.

chimneys.description: Cf of chimneys, tanks and rooftop equipment; None: not covered.

rooftop.description: Increase of the force on rooftop equipment; None: none.
